description: This file defines the QuotaManager class in the Aws\Retry namespace, responsible for managing retry quotas for AWS SDK operations, including tracking available capacity, handling retry logic, and releasing capacity based on request outcomes.

classes.name: QuotaManager
classes.description: A class that manages retry quotas for AWS SDK requests, controlling the number of retries allowed based on available capacity and request outcomes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the QuotaManager with optional configuration parameters such as initial retry tokens, increment steps, and costs for retries and timeouts.

methods.name: hasRetryQuota
methods.description: Determines if a retry is permitted based on current quota and the result, updating capacity accordingly.

methods.name: releaseToQuota
methods.description: Releases capacity back to the quota based on the outcome of a request, effectively replenishing available capacity for successful responses.

methods.name: getAvailableCapacity
methods.description: Returns the current available retry capacity.
